name: aasthi-payment-risk
kind: logistic regression, fitted by batch gradient descent with L2

features.name: log_amount
features.description: log of the payment amount in rupees

features.name: amount_vs_recent_mean
features.description: this amount divided by the payer's recent average, capped at 10

features.name: txn_count_10m
features.description: payments by this payer in the last ten minutes

features.name: txn_count_24h
features.description: payments by this payer in the last day

features.name: log_total_24h
features.description: log of the payer's rupee total over the last day

features.name: log_account_age_min
features.description: log of the account age in minutes

features.name: near_threshold
features.description: how close the amount sits under a reporting threshold, 0 to 1

features.name: repeat_amount_share
features.description: share of recent payments within 5 percent of this amount

features.name: odd_hour
features.description: 1 when the payment lands between midnight and five in the morning

features.name: kyc_tier_strength
features.description: 0 unknown or expired, 0.5 minimum KYC, 1 full KYC

features.name: kyc_face_to_face
features.description: 1 when the route that granted the tier was face-to-face equivalent

features.name: log_kyc_age_days
features.description: log of the days since the identity was verified

features.name: cap_pressure
features.description: this amount against the tier's per-payment ceiling, capped at 2

dataSource: Synthetic. 12,000 payments from the seeded generator in cmd/trainrisk, 70/30 split. No real payment data was used, because none is available to this project.
limits: Trained on synthetic data, so the metrics describe the generator and not the world.
Advisory only: the published rules in fraud.go make the decision.
Linear and small on purpose, so every coefficient and every contribution is readable.
Fourteen features: the payment, the payer's recent history, and the identity the KYC desk recorded. It sees nothing else.
